name: track-pocket
description: TRACK.Pocket: pocket music maker in one HTML file.

scripts.android:init: npm run www && npx cap add android && node scripts/android-permissions.js && node scripts/android-icons.js
scripts.android:apk: npm run www && npx cap sync android && cd native && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run www && npx cap sync android && cd native && ./gradlew assembleRelease
